name: Contemporary Digital / Neo-Graphic
core_principles: systems and components rather than one-off compositions
designed first for a small screen in a scrolling context
consistent spacing tokens and a fixed type scale
clarity of action — the next step is always visible
adaptation across many surfaces without redrawing
visual_traits: geometric or neo-grotesque sans across the whole hierarchy
generous internal padding and rounded containing forms
soft layered depth through elevation rather than through perspective
a saturated accent reserved for action elements
component repetition as a visible organising principle
composition: Stacked and modular. Content is arranged in self-contained blocks that read cleanly in a vertical scroll, with a strong opening block and a clear terminal action. Composition is designed to survive reordering and truncation.

grid.logic: Component-based spacing system built on a fixed base unit, typically four or eight pixels, with a simple column structure that collapses predictably at smaller sizes.

typography.logic: One versatile sans family across all levels with a compact scale. Weight is the main differentiator, sizes are drawn from a fixed token set, and line length is controlled for small screens.

color.logic: Neutral surface palette with semantic colour roles — one accent for action, one for emphasis, greys for structure. Contrast floors are set by accessibility requirements rather than by taste.

imagery: Bright, clean and lightly styled. Product-in-context shots, screen content and illustration used interchangeably. Images are treated as replaceable content within a fixed frame.
materiality: Screen-native. Soft shadow, subtle blur and translucency stand in for physical material, and any texture is applied sparingly as an accent.
shape_language: Rounded rectangles, pill forms and simple icons. Containment is the dominant device — nearly everything sits inside a defined block.
anti_stereotype: This is a systems discipline, not a look. Rounded corners and a soft gradient applied to an unstructured layout produce the surface of the movement without the component logic that gives it value.
Gradient blobs and glassmorphic panels are a passing trend layer, not the movement, and doctrine ranks contemporary trend below every structural consideration.
Because the system is so easy to apply, it is the most likely source of creative repetition across a brand's output — check it against creative memory before choosing it again.
